en.title: The Fish That Kept Growing | Matsya and Manu
en.description:
A tiny fish begged a king to save it. That fish was God.

The story of Matsya, the fish avatar of Vishnu, and King Satyavrata, who became Manu.

Retold from the Bhagavata Purana, Canto 8, chapter 24.
